questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: A palace opened as a national museum
questions.learningObjective: Describe a palace opened as a national museum

stimulus.body: Notice du musée: « Ce palais, longtemps réservé à la cour, est désormais ouvert à tous les visiteurs. Les collections et les décors sont conservés et présentés au public dans les salles restaurées. » La notice ajoute que la vente du bâtiment est exclue et qu'aucune partie n'est fermée au public.

questions.stem: D'après l'avis du musée, quel objectif déclaré est conforme à ce texte ?

options.text: To clear the site for a new administrative building.
options.misconception: treats the palace as surplus property rather than heritage

options.text: To preserve heritage and open it au public.
To transfer the building to private owners.
options.misconception: contradicts the notice, which excludes sale

options.text: To store the collections away from visitors.
options.misconception: reverses the stated aim of public display

questions.explanation: The notice pairs conservation of the decorations with free access for visitors, which is exactly the preserve-and-open purpose in B. Clearing the site (A) and private sale (C) would destroy the heritage the notice says is protected, and closing the rooms (D) contradicts the statement that no part is withheld from the public. The wording of the notice, not trivia about palaces, settles the item.
questions.hint: Look for conservation plus public access in the notice.
